stem:
Meena fills a tall plastic bottle completely with water and closes the cap tightly.
She then makes a small hole in the side wall of the bottle, near the bottom.
What does Meena observe, and what does it show about the pressure exerted by water?

options.text: No water comes out, because water pushes only downward on the bottom of the bottle
Water flows out through the hole, showing that water also pushes on the side walls of the bottle
No water comes out, because the cap is closed and air cannot enter the bottle
Water flows out only if the bottle is squeezed, showing that water does not push on the side walls by itself

teacher.key_rationale: Water in a container exerts pressure on the side walls as well as the bottom, so water flows out through a side hole even without squeezing; the correct observation is described in option B.
